allocation.title: Allocation among beneficiaries

modeHint.ALL: Every beneficiary of this vault can see this asset (default).
modeHint.EXCLUSIVE: Only one person receives this asset. You can name a backup who receives it if that person declines.
modeHint.PROPORTIONAL: Split between several people by percentage; shares must total 100%. Only for assets that need a legal claim.
modeHint.JOINT_CONSENSUS: The asset opens only when enough people in the chosen group approve together.

allocation.vipNote: Percentage split, backup beneficiary and joint approval require a VIP plan.
